scope: All 42 previously published Beginner positions; editorial repetition review plus legal all-root/defensive replay. Removed entries are not declared tactically incorrect.

decisions.reason: Baseline: the Knight uncovers a Rook check and collects the Queen on its next move.
Knight gives a direct check while the stationary Rook gains access to the Queen; contrasts with the stationary-piece check in 01.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Rxf1, đối phương có thể chơi Kxc2 để bắt Mã. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Mã lấy Hậu.

decisions.reason: Diagonal discovery: Knight relocates to attack a Queen while the Bishop supplies the check.
Direct Knight check opens a diagonal Bishop attack on the Queen; the Knight, not the Bishop, gives check.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Bxe7, đối phương có thể chơi Kxb5 để bắt Mã. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Mã lấy Hậu.

decisions.reason: Bishop changes diagonal while uncovering a Rook check, then takes the Queen on the new diagonal.
An attacked Bishop leaves a rank with check, exposing the Queen behind it to the Rook.
Another Knight double-check setup; 38 additionally introduces the Queen as the revealed checker.
Repeats the Knight-check/Bishop-capture decision with shifted diagonal geometry.
Knight opens a horizontal Rook check; the king must leave the line and the stationary Rook captures the rear Rook (discovery plus skewer).
Repeats a Knight check uncovering a horizontal Rook capture; extra branches add length rather than a new idea.
Rook vacates a Bishop diagonal with tempo; the Bishop checks the king and captures the Rook behind it.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Bxd4, đối phương có thể chơi Kxd4 để bắt Tượng. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Tượng lấy Xe.

decisions.reason: Rook moves along its file to give direct check while a Bishop collects the newly exposed Rook; few defensive branches.

Knight uncovers check and wins the exchange against a king-defended Rook; unlike 01, the king can capture the Knight afterward. The solution explicitly explains Knight for Rook rather than claiming an intact Rook gain.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Nxc5, đối phương có thể chơi Kxc5 để bắt Mã. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Mã lấy Xe.

decisions.reason: Same Knight-check/Rook-capture mechanism with a Rook replacing the Queen target.
Same Knight relocation and Bishop discovered check; changing Queen to Rook target adds little.
Same direct Knight check and stationary Bishop capture with a different target and diagonal length.
Repeats Bishop diagonal change under a Rook discovered check; changed squares do not add a decision.
Vertical counterpart to 06: the Bishop must find a safe checking square near the enemy king while vacating the Rook file; retained as the single file example.
Repeats the Knight/Bishop checking discovery; a check on the final capture does not warrant another exercise.
Same Knight-check/Bishop-Queen-capture mechanism on shifted squares.
Same Knight relocation under Rook discovered check followed by a Queen capture.
Same Knight direct check and horizontal Rook capture; different squares only.
Unlike 11, the moving Rook itself wins the Queen after the Bishop supplies check; the moving piece prepares the capture.
Same Rook direct check and stationary Bishop capture; changed target alone is redundant.
Same single-step pawn clearance and Rook skewer. Keep one rather than both colors/shifts.
Single-square pawn advance opens a rank check and a Rook skewer; retained as the one straightforward pawn-push example.
Two-square pawn advance avoids Kxc3, which is possible after c3+. The contrast between legal pawn advances is a concrete extra decision, not a color pair; separated from 26.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Nước c3+ cũng thắng vật chất nhưng cho phép Kxc3. Nước c4+ mở cùng đường chiếu và giữ được Tốt trước nước đáp của Vua.

decisions.reason: Repeats the two-square pawn clearance/Rook-skewer pattern with reversed color and shifted rank.
Pawn capture gives direct check while opening a Rook file against the Queen; both the diagonal capture and the opened file matter.
Quiet pawn capture uncovers a Bishop pin of the defending Rook, preventing the pawn recapture; differs from checking pawn capture 29.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Bxb6, đối phương có thể chơi Kxb6 để bắt Tượng. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Tượng lấy Tốt và Xe.

decisions.reason: Near-mirror King clearance and Rook skewer; only one king-opening example is needed.
King vacates a Rook rank safely to uncover check and a skewer; one king-opening example suffices.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Rxh8, đối phương có thể chơi Kxh8 để bắt Xe. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Xe lấy Hậu.

decisions.reason: Same quiet Rook relocation producing Bishop-versus-Rook and Rook-versus-Knight threats.
Quiet Rook relocation opens a Bishop attack on a Rook and attacks the Knight. The defender can move the first target but cannot save both.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Bxc6, đối phương có thể chơi Kxc6 để bắt Tượng. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Tượng lấy Xe.

decisions.reason: Double check by Bishop and Rook; the Bishop relocates to a diagonal from which it captures the Queen.
Another Knight/Bishop double-check example; 38 retains the Knight mechanism and adds Queen participation.
The revealed attacker is a Queen; the Bishop gives direct check and opens a Queen file to the target.
Double check by Knight and Queen on a diagonal; the Knight captures the rear Rook. Contrasts with the Bishop/Rook coordination in 35.
Bishop captures a pawn to uncover Rook check, then captures the Queen; the initial capture is not an unrelated free gain.
Knight captures a pawn without check, uncovering a Bishop pin that prevents Rx d5; unlike 30, the mover is a Knight and several legal equivalent preparations remain accepted.
Same Queen check opening a Bishop attack on the opposing Queen, with similar interposition replies.
Queen vacates a Bishop diagonal with check; defensive Queen interpositions have concrete capture continuations.
decisions.solutionSuffix: Sau Bxg6, đối phương có thể chơi Kxg6 để bắt Tượng. Bên giải vẫn thắng vật chất: đổi Tượng lấy Hậu.
